cues.en: I hope you were able to implement a hybrid recommender on your own!
cues.zh: 希望你已經能自己實作混合推薦器！

cues.en: It's a way to tie together a lot of different things we've learned under one umbrella, which is a fitting way to finish this course.
cues.zh: 這能把學過的許多不同內容整合在一起，很適合作為本課程的結尾。

cues.en: If you'd like to take a look at my solution, open up Spyder and control shift W to close out anything else you may have open.
cues.zh: 如果想看我的解答，開啟 Spyder，按 Ctrl + Shift + W，關閉其他可能開著的檔案。

cues.en: Then, open up the contents of the Hybrid folder in the course materials.
cues.zh: 接著開啟課程教材 Hybrid 資料夾的內容。

cues.en: Start by looking at the HybridAlgorithm.py file.
cues.zh: 先看 HybridAlgorithm.py 檔案。

cues.en: It's rather surprisingly small, which is a testament to the architecture of the recommender library we've built here.
cues.zh: 它短得出乎意料，這正好證明我們建立的推薦程式庫架構很好。

cues.en: It allows us to easily combine different algorithms that might do totally different things, thanks to having a common interface on every recommender.
cues.zh: 因為每個推薦器都有共同介面，所以很容易結合可能執行完全不同工作的演算法。

cues.en: The init function just takes in a list of algorithms that derive from AlgoBase, and an associated list of weights you want to assign to each one when producing final rating estimates.
cues.zh: init 函式只接收衍生自 AlgoBase 的演算法清單，以及產生最終預測評分時，要指派給各演算法的權重清單。

cues.en: All the fit function does is iterate through each algorithm in our list, training each one with our training dataset by calling their fit functions in turn.
cues.zh: fit 函式只需要逐一走訪清單中的演算法，依序呼叫各自的 fit 函式，用訓練資料集訓練每個演算法。

cues.en: All this code does is iterate through each algorithm, calling estimate on each one and combining the resulting estimates in a weighted average, which makes up the final rating estimate that we return.
cues.zh: 這段程式碼只需要逐一走訪各演算法，對每個呼叫 estimate，再將所得估計值做加權平均，成為回傳的最終預測評分。

cues.en: That's all there is to the heart of this hybrid recommender.
cues.zh: 這就是混合推薦器核心的全部內容。

cues.en: It's a very simple approach, and as we said, there's more than one way to do it.
cues.zh: 這是非常簡單的方法。如前所述，做法不只一種。

cues.en: You could have a hierarchy of recommenders that only fill in individual top-N slots if a better recommender was unable to produce results.
cues.zh: 也可以建立推薦器的階層，只有較好的推薦器無法產生結果時，才由其他推薦器填補個別 Top-N 位置。

cues.en: Or, you could imagine a system that actually learns the correct weights between different recommenders based on the results on online experiments or you could even create a system
cues.zh: 或者，可以想像一個系統，根據線上實驗結果，實際學習不同推薦器的正確權重。甚至可以建立系統，

cues.en: to personalize those weights based on user attributes or contextual information.
cues.zh: 根據使用者屬性或情境資訊，個人化這些權重。

cues.en: But for now, this is a good starting point.
cues.zh: 不過目前，這是不錯的起點。

cues.en: Let's shift our attention to the HybridTest.py file.
cues.zh: 把注意力轉到 HybridTest.py。

cues.en: Nothing much new here, we're using the same Evaluator module we've used throughout the course, only this time we're comparing RBMAlgorithm, the ContentKNNAlgorithm, and a HybridAlgorithm
cues.zh: 這裡沒有太多新內容，使用的是整門課一直用的 Evaluator 模組，只是這次比較 RBMAlgorithm、ContentKNNAlgorithm，以及 HybridAlgorithm，

cues.en: that combines the two.
cues.zh: 也就是結合前兩者的演算法。

cues.en: Line 40 is where the HybridAlgorithm is created, and you can see we've arbitrarily chosen equal weights for both of its component algorithms.
cues.zh: 第 40 行建立 HybridAlgorithm，可以看到，我們任意為兩個組成演算法選了相同權重。

cues.en: Again, in a real system, you'd want to run experiments to find the optimal weights to use and maybe even personalize those weights, or work in contextual information to them.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，真正的系統應該透過實驗找最佳權重，甚至個人化權重，或把情境資訊納入。

cues.en: Both the RBM and ContentKNNAlgorithm approaches take a fair amount of time to run, and we need to run each one twice for this experiment, so hit the play button to run this,
cues.zh: RBM 與 ContentKNNAlgorithm 都需要不少時間，而這個實驗各要執行兩次，所以按下執行，

cues.en: and just let your computer do its thing for an hour or so.
cues.zh: 讓電腦自行運作大約一個小時。

cues.en: We'll come back when it's done.
cues.zh: 完成後再回來。

cues.en: Let's scroll up to where accuracy from all three are measured.
cues.zh: 往上捲到比較三者準確度的地方。

cues.en: We can see that RBM has a rather poor score of 1.1891.
cues.zh: 可以看到，RBM 的分數是 1.1891，相當差。

cues.en: Can we make it better by applying content information to the results as well?
cues.zh: 若也把內容資訊套用到結果，能改善嗎？

cues.en: Well, the answer is yes!
cues.zh: 答案是可以！

cues.en: The hybrid approach outperformed RBM substantially, since our accuracy metric on content-based recs exceeds RBM by quite a bit.
cues.zh: 混合方法大幅優於 RBM，因為內容式推薦的準確度指標，比 RBM 好很多。

cues.en: But, we know RBM's score is bad mostly because it underestimates everything pretty consistently, it has its strengths, when given enough training data.
cues.zh: 但我們知道，RBM 分數差，主要是因為幾乎總是低估所有評分；只要訓練資料足夠，它仍有優點。

cues.en: But it really struggles in low-data situations such as ours.
cues.zh: 不過，像我們這種資料少的情況，真的讓它很吃力。

cues.en: Content-based recommendations don't care about how much behavior data you have, but of course they have their limits, you want to take individual behavior data into account when you can.
cues.zh: 內容式推薦不在乎行為資料有多少，但當然也有限制。能考慮個別行為資料時，你還是會希望納入。

cues.en: Our hybrid approach gives us the best of both worlds, with an accuracy measure that's in between the two.
cues.zh: 混合方法讓我們兼取兩者優點，準確度指標介於兩者之間。

cues.en: As we said, there are examples where a hybrid recommender can outperform either of its constituent algorithms when run independently.
cues.zh: 如前所述，有些例子中，混合推薦器可以勝過任何單獨執行的組成演算法。

cues.en: Session-based recommendations are an example, as is the ensemble approach that won the Netflix prize.
cues.zh: 工作階段式推薦就是例子，Netflix Prize 得獎的集成方法也是。

cues.en: A good hybrid recommender won't just average out the performance of each one, it will leverage the strengths of some recommenders to augment the weaknesses of others
cues.zh: 好的混合推薦器，不會只是把各個演算法的表現取平均，而會利用某些推薦器的強項，補足其他推薦器的弱點，

cues.en: and leave you with a system that's more than just the sum of its parts.
cues.zh: 讓系統的效果超越各部分單純相加。

cues.en: We've certainly covered a lot in this course so far, and now you've seen how to tie these different algorithms together.
cues.zh: 到目前為止，課程已涵蓋很多內容，現在你也看過如何把這些不同演算法串在一起。

cues.en: Developing recommender systems sometimes feels like more of an art than a science, and choosing how to combine different algorithms can feel like choosing different colors in a painting that complement each other.
cues.zh: 開發推薦系統，有時感覺更像藝術，而非科學；選擇如何結合不同演算法，就像挑選畫作中能互相襯托的不同顏色。

cues.en: At this point, I hope your palette is filled with lots of different algorithms and ideas surrounding recommender systems, and you're ready to go apply what you've learned to real problems!
cues.zh: 現在，希望你的調色盤已經裝滿各種推薦系統的演算法與想法，準備好把所學應用到真實問題！
